name: EV fleet aggregator
size_reference: Overnight depot and home charging aggregated across Texas metros. A single large electric bus or truck depot is roughly 5-20 MW (utility make-ready and interconnection filings), so 500 MW stands for a regional aggregator (illustrative).

name: Data center (flexible batch)
size_reference: Large hyperscale data-center campuses draw 100-300+ MW (public utility filings; ERCOT tracks loads of 75 MW and up as large loads). Only deferrable batch work (training, rendering, backups) is bid; illustrative.

name: Office portfolio (pre-cooling)
size_reference: A large downtown office tower's HVAC peaks at a few MW (building energy benchmarking disclosures); 150 MW stands for a portfolio of dozens of towers across Houston and Dallas pre-cooling ahead of the afternoon peak (illustrative).

name: Cold-storage portfolio
size_reference: A large refrigerated warehouse draws roughly 1-5 MW (utility efficiency case studies); 80 MW stands for a statewide cold-chain portfolio using its thermal mass to shift a quarter of its daily refrigeration energy (illustrative).

name: Municipal water pumping
size_reference: Pumping for a large city water system uses tens of MW (municipal utility energy reports); 120 MW stands for several Texas metro systems filling storage tanks before the evening peak (illustrative).
